task_instance: Author an execution plan for a small accepted implementation direction (add a delete(item_id) method to a sample Python TodoStore) following the skill's Output Contract and Default Shape, then render the sibling HTML tracker with the skill's bundled render_plan.py.
evidence: Created a minimal sample repo in the work dir under sample_repo/ (todoapp/store.py, tests/test_store.py, AGENTS.md) so the plan could name real files/commands. Wrote sample_repo/PLAN.md as an execution plan conforming to the skill contract: accepted implementation direction paragraph; ## Status dated bullet; one ### Milestone 1 with exactly Toc/Goal/Acceptance Criteria/Checklist; a mandatory first checklist item forcing the executing agent to recite the workflow (milestone order, exit criteria, named commands, test-first rule, self-check gate, inherited AGENTS.md repo constraint) before editing code; flat checklists with concrete loci (todoapp/store.py, tests/test_store.py), test-first sequencing, and the named proof command 'python -m pytest -q'; observable acceptance criteria tied to a proof artifact (a named regression test). The Live HTML Tracker step uses the skill's bundled renderer: direct execution of the renderer from the skill's own directory was blocked by the runtime's external-code policy, so (per the run's amendment permitting copying skill files into the work dir) I copied render_plan.py into the work dir and ran 'python3 render_plan.py sample_repo/PLAN.md', which wrote sample_repo/PLAN.html (exit 0, ~22.9 KB). Verified the HTML: <title> equals the plan title, the milestone heading and all 5 checklist items rendered (8 'checklist' matches), the recital first step is present, and it begins with <!doctype html>. The skill's referenced files (render_plan.py and references/review-prompts.md) were all present next to SKILL.md.
